nodes.name: Development occurs at a scenario/chapter end or a suitable narrative pause
A successful skill use earns one check; bonus-die-only successes and opposed losers do not
Each checked skill receives at most one improvement roll per development phase
Cthulhu Mythos and Credit Rating never receive improvement checks
Roll 1D100; above current skill or above 95 gains 1D10 and may exceed 100
A skill attaining 90 or more during development grants 2D6 current SAN
A roll altered by Luck earns no skill improvement check
After each session, D100 above current Luck gains 1D10, capped at 99
Development may include self-help, finance review, backstory changes, and awfulness-limit decay
Each development phase reduces per-creature habituation totals by one
Self-help, employment/Credit Rating, and free-form backstory changes are source rules outside the deterministic development.settle adapter
Invoke state.end_session for the source-defined end-session settlement
Invoke development.settle for the source-defined settle-ending settlement
